name: Mikko Virtanen
bio:
Mikko's motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by the iconic Finnish drivers of the era. He pursued a degree in engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, and quickly found himself working in the support ranks of various European racing series. His dedication and sharp analytical skills propelled him upwards, taking on increasing responsibilities in team management.

At Eurofarma RC, Mikko is known for his meticulous approach to operations. He believes in empowering his team through clear communication and fostering a collaborative environment. He focuses relentlessly on optimizing processes and ensuring seamless execution on race weekends. What sets Mikko apart is his ability to identify subtle inefficiencies and implement innovative solutions, often unnoticed by others. His experience and commitment make him an invaluable asset to the team.

While intensely focused on the task at hand, Mikko also understands the importance of team morale and camaraderie. He actively participates in team-building activities and fosters a supportive atmosphere within the garage. He values open communication and encourages his team to share their ideas and concerns, creating a space where everyone feels valued and heard.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Mikko is of average height with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Finnish coffee brewed at precisely 8:00 AM every morning.
